nodes.label: Feature Folder System
nodes.rationale: Organize codebase by feature folders to keep related code highly cohesive and modular.

nodes.label: ESLint Import Validation
nodes.rationale: Enforce strict module boundaries and project structure with two optional plugin configurations.

nodes.label: PR Submission Checklist
nodes.rationale: Pre-flight checks including linting, production compilation, environment template sync, and migration generation to ensure code sanity and schema safety.

nodes.label: Database Migration Procedure
nodes.rationale: Drizzle migrations are stored locally under src/drizzle/migrations and must be applied to the Neon database instance as a pre-deploy or post-deploy hook to prevent out-of-sync schemas.

nodes.label: ESLint Import Boundaries
nodes.rationale: ESLint boundaries plugin active in `.eslintrc.json` enforces import boundary rules to prevent tight coupling and cross-feature imports.

nodes.label: Feature Directory Pattern
nodes.rationale: Organizes features into self-contained directory patterns (components, schemas, server/actions, server/db) wrapping queries with dbCache for tag-based caching.

nodes.label: dbCache Caching Pattern
nodes.rationale: Uses dbCache wrapper + revalidateDbCache for tag-based invalidation (global/user/id tags) to handle DB query caching.

nodes.label: Env Validation Strategy
nodes.rationale: Uses @t3-oss/env-nextjs to validate server vars and client vars at runtime, preventing direct access of process.env.

nodes.label: Feature Sliced Design (FSD)
nodes.rationale: Strictly adheres to Feature Sliced Design architecture and folder structure to structure the project into global shared elements and isolated features.

nodes.label: FSD Isolation Principle
nodes.rationale: Features are self-contained and NOT shareable across other features to prevent tight coupling.

nodes.label: FSD Import Boundary Rules
nodes.rationale: Strict dependency rules enforced via ESLint to prevent cross-feature imports. Features cannot import from other features, and shared folders cannot import from features or app folders.

nodes.label: FSD Bridge Exception
nodes.rationale: src/lib/permissions.ts (shared) is allowed to import from features' db folders to evaluate access control across multiple domains (e.g. checking subscription tiers and product count).

nodes.label: FSD Database Query Caching Pattern
nodes.rationale: Database queries in feature db folders should use the dbCache wrapper (Next.js unstable_cache helper) defined in src/lib/cache.ts for optimized server-side rendering.

nodes.label: FSD Environment Variable Validation
nodes.rationale: Environment variables are validated at runtime using @t3-oss/env-nextjs and split into server.ts and client.ts. Direct process.env reads are prohibited.
